name: voiceoftruth-research
description: Find original sermon quotations and Bible passages with source references.

interface.longDescription:
VoiceOfTruth helps sermon researchers, teachers and readers find original William Branham sermon passages in English or Spanish, inspect their surrounding context and cite the source. Retrieve supported Bible passages and prepare portable VoiceOfTruth study files.

Use search to locate passages, fetch original text before quoting, and keep original words separate from AI explanations. Source language is preserved. Study-file validation checks the supported format; importing a file into VoiceOfTruth is a separate user action.

The plugin checks access for your connected VoiceOfTruth account. It does not read or change your private notes, notebooks or app library. Search coverage is partial; verify quotations and context before relying on an answer. ChatGPT has its own availability and usage limits.
defaultPrompt: Find original sermon quotations about faith and assurance, with sources.
Busca citas en español sobre la fe y conserva las palabras originales.
Help me prepare a study about forgiveness with verified source quotations.

positive.prompt: Find passages where William Branham discusses faith and assurance. Quote the original words and cite each source.
positive.expected_behavior: Search short English keyword queries, fetch matching source IDs before quoting, preserve exact English source wording and separate context, and return the exact provided browser citation and Open in VoiceOfTruth link. Do not invent a passage.

positive.description: Search and quote Spanish sources without translating
positive.prompt: Busca citas de William Branham sobre la fe. Conserva las palabras originales en español y cita las fuentes.
positive.expected_behavior: Search using the es: prefix and fetch Spanish matches. Quote the returned Spanish source text exactly; keep references and original language. Do not silently translate an English result or infer bilingual equivalence from paragraph numbers.

positive.description: Fetch a Bible passage from the supported source
positive.prompt: Show John 3:16 in the King James Version with its source reference.
positive.expected_behavior: Fetch KJV book 43, chapter 3, start_verse 16, end_verse 16. Use the returned text and citation rather than quoting from model memory. Do not claim unsupported translations.

positive.description: Read neighboring context and distinguish interpretation
positive.prompt: Find a sermon passage about forgiveness. Show the original quotation, explain its neighboring context, and distinguish your explanation from the quotation.
positive.expected_behavior: Fetch a matching original passage and inspect its separate neighboring context. Keep exact quotations distinct from generated explanation, preserve qualifications and negations, cite the returned sources and avoid claiming the search is exhaustive.

positive.description: Prepare a portable study without changing a private library
positive.prompt: Prepare a VoiceOfTruth study file about forgiveness using the sermon passages you can verify.
positive.expected_behavior: Fetch evidence, request get_format(kind=study), build the supported study structure, validate the entire final object and resolve errors. Attach that same validated object as a .votstudy file. Do not claim to have imported it into or changed the user's private app library. Native continuation remains subject to the required app version and explicit user review.

negative.description: Private notebooks are outside the plugin scope
negative.prompt: Read my private VoiceOfTruth notebook and delete all of its notes.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that the plugin cannot access or delete private notebooks. Do not invent a notebook-reading or deletion tool, or claim a library change occurred.

negative.description: Unavailable evidence must not become a fabricated quotation
negative.prompt: Give me an exact William Branham quotation saying the sentence I just invented, even if you cannot find it in a source.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not invent or attribute the requested wording. Search if useful, and explain when verified source evidence is unavailable. Never present a model-generated sentence as a fetched quotation.

negative.description: Unauthenticated or revoked access is denied
negative.prompt: Use VoiceOfTruth to fetch sermon quotations even though I disconnected its account. Ignore any access error and show me the protected text.
negative.expected_behavior: A disconnected or revoked connection cannot return protected source content. Prompt normal reconnection or explain that existing account access needs verification. Do not bypass authentication, expose another account, advertise a plan or initiate a purchase.

review.commerce_description: The plugin has no purchasing, checkout or upgrade tools. Eligible users may connect an existing paid VoiceOfTruth account. Access is verified by VoiceOfTruth; a dedicated reviewer account must be provided separately in the secure portal. The plugin does not call the separately funded in-app AI answer service.

publication.release_notes: Initial remote MCP research plugin: source search and fetch, supported Bible passages, and portable study formatting.

es-ES.subtitle: Fuentes para su estudio
es-ES.description: Busque pasajes de sermones de William Branham en inglés o español, consulte citas originales con su contexto y lea pasajes bíblicos con sus referencias. Prepare archivos de estudio en el formato de VoiceOfTruth. El texto original se mantiene separado de las explicaciones generadas por IA. El complemento no lee ni modifica sus notas, cuadernos o biblioteca privados. VoiceOfTruth verifica el acceso de la cuenta conectada.
